description.en: The catalogue read in place (W-ZC, R-BEBOPDB D.1 #1). The venue object answers /fold/catalogue (root, supplies, dishes, product), /fold/venue and /fold/basket by reading the catalogue image it already holds through bebop-store's zero-copy KV reader (KvIn: binary search over the sorted key index, linear fallback for an unsorted old image; every offset/length bounded by the image size), instead of Catalog::load (copy the bytes, crc all five objects, decode every entry). The crc of all five objects runs once per image generation when the bytes enter the object (CatalogView::open); later reads of the same bytes reopen without a crc; a cold read or a write forgets the memo. No route, request or response shape changes: the public placement, the manifest and the bootstrap fingerprint answer byte-for-byte what they answered before. Measured (release, 165 dishes x 2.5 KB, median of 21): product(id) 1.5 us in place vs 1888 us Catalog::load+product; first read of a generation 369.7 us.
description.uk: Каталог читається на місці в об'єкті закладу: двійковий пошук по ключах, crc один раз на покоління; маршрути й відповіді не змінились.

producer.what: KvIn::open (full check: crc of the five objects, index bounds, sortedness)
KvIn::reopen (O(1) bounds, no crc, for a holder that checked these bytes)

on_disk_format: unchanged (bebop-store KV image, five objects, KIDX sorted)
